jobs.description: Job#: 3047313 Job Description: Data Engineer Location: Lone Tree, Colorado (Onsite) Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to support the development of modern data products and AI-enabled analytics capabilities. The primary focus of this position is to design and build Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) data marts and supporting data pipelines in a cloud environment. The role will also help maintain an existing digital marketing data mart that supports business intelligence and analytics. Key Responsibilities Design and build scalable AEO data marts in Google Cloud Platform. Develop automated pipelines that ingest data from third-party AEO vendor APIs. Use Python to build reusable API integrations, extraction processes, and data-transformation components. Manage API authentication, pagination, response processing, error handling, and logging. Create well-structured analytical data models that support reporting, analysis, and future AI use cases. Write complex SQL from scratch to transform, integrate, validate, and prepare AEO data. Integrate AEO vendor data with relevant digital marketing and core business datasets. Establish data-quality checks, reconciliation processes, and monitoring. Document source structures, business rules, data grain, refresh frequency, and transformation logic. Maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance the existing digital marketing data mart. Required Qualifications Professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, or a related technical field. Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to write complex SQL from scratch. Proficiency in Python for API integration, data extraction, automation, and transformation. Hands-on experience designing and building data pipelines and analytical data models. Experience integrating data from REST APIs or other third-party interfaces. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform and cloud-based data services. Experience building data marts or other curated analytical data products. Knowledge of dimensional modeling, data grain, and transformation logic. Experience with data-quality testing, validation, logging, and monitoring. Experience using source control and collaborative development practices. Strong technical documentation and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience building data products for Answer Engine Optimization, search analytics, or digital visibility. Experience working with third-party marketing or analytics vendor APIs. Experience with Adobe Analytics, clickstream data, or other event-level digital behavioral data. Experience with modern analytics-engineering technologies, including dbt, dlt, and DuckDB. Working knowledge of modern AI capabilities, including LLM-based applications and retrieval-augmented generation. Experience with business intelligence and analytics platforms such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Familiarity with GitHub, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD practices. Experience using Jira or a similar work-management platform. Previous experience in financial services or another regulated industry. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Build at Auger Auger is the autonomous operating system for supply chains — the layer that finally allows disparate systems like ERP, WMS, and TMS to work together instead of against each other. Most supply chain software surfaces problems and waits for a human to act. Auger solves them. Our AI detects disruptions, evaluates trade-offs, and executes decisions automatically — moving from signal to action in seconds, not weeks. We eliminate the Coordination Tax: the billions in capital and time lost when disconnected systems force the best people in the business to become the Human API between planning and execution. At Auger, we design autonomy into our systems. We expect the same from our people. That Means Clear ownership, not decision by consensus First principles over inherited patterns Shipping systems, not slide decks Fast feedback from reality, not opinions If you want to build, ship, and iterate against reality, Auger is for you. Auger was founded by Dave Clark and is backed by $150M from Oak HC/FT and Eclipse Capital. Our team works from Bellevue, WA and Dallas, TX. About The Role Build the data foundation that powers Auger’s Supply Chain OS, AI systems, and execution workflows. Auger is building an operating system for supply chain teams. Our customers rely on Auger to understand reality and change it: reporting, AI-powered decision support, and write-back execution systems that operate at scale. At the core of this system is Data Engineering. This role owns the transformation of messy, customer-shared data into a unified, production-grade ontology that directly powers analytics, AI workflows, and execution systems. This is not a “move data from A to B” role. This is semantic ownership at the heart of the product. What You'll do As a Data Engineer, You Will Leverage New And Existing Customer Data Sources Ingested Into Auger’s Core Data Lake And Transform Them Into Our Ontology. We're Seeking Teammates Who Love Data Of All Kinds, Are Masters Of Building Efficient, Scalable, Operable Data Pipelines, And Are Ready To Take Hands-on Coding Ownership In The Following Areas Own the data lifecycle end-to-end, from ingestion to production-ready ontology Ingest data from databases, streams, batch files, and incremental feeds Design and operate medallion-style lakehouse pipelines (bronze → silver → gold) Transform raw inputs into a consistent digital twin of supply chain reality Serve high-quality data to analytics, AI workflows, and write-back systems Own data correctness and reliability in production, including monitoring, on-call, and incident response Build data quality checks, validations, and safe backfill strategies Use AI-assisted tools responsibly, reviewing and hardening generated code Reduce complexity by simplifying pipelines and automating repetitive work What You Bring Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or other data-intensive discipline with substantive engineering experience 2+ years demonstrated development experience using SQL, Scala, Spark, Flink, Beam, and/or Python 2+ years demonstrated experience in data management (structured and unstructured) and modern database technologies Experience building and operating production data pipelines in distributed systems Hands-on experience with lakehouse or warehouse architectures Strong schema design skills for structured and semi-structured data A production mindset—you’ve owned systems that break and fixed them Experience supporting AI/ML or AI-powered products Familiarity with streaming or incremental processing Experience with data quality, observability, or anomaly detection A deep curiosity and eagerness to problem solve without a playbook. If you require intense structure and process, this is not the place for you Ability to work collaboratively through ambiguity, with urgency, patience, and good humor Compensation & Benefits As part of our commitment to People Powered Greatness, we invest in our team members with competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits to support your health, financial future, and daily life. The package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, and commuter benefits. Total compensation may include a combination of a competitive base salary and equity. Your initial placement within our salary range will be based on your experience, qualifications. The base pay range for this role is $150,000 – $200,000 per year. Auger considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Additionally, our privacy policy is available at https://auger.com/privacy-notice/ .

This role reports into the data and analytics leadership team. This role suits someone who enjoys understanding how the entire data workflow operates and takes ownership of making it reliable. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About this role Brighton is a retail accessories brand doing genuinely innovative work in data and analytics. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who is comfortable owning data workflows end-to-end, from ingestion and transformation through deployment, orchestration, monitoring, and production support. This is a small, hands-on data team, so the role extends beyond writing SQL and Python. You'll help maintain the development and runtime environments that our data pipelines depend on and will be expected to troubleshoot issues across the application, orchestration, container, and infrastructure layers. This role reports to the Head of Data & Analytics. The kind of engineer who will do well at Brighton You don't need to be a dedicated DevOps engineer, but you should be comfortable going below the data layer when something breaks. If a pipeline fails because of Python code, you'll investigate the code. If a container won't start, you'll investigate Docker. If an orchestration worker isn't behaving correctly, you'll inspect the worker and its logs. If credentials, networking, dependencies, or the runtime environment are the problem, you're comfortable digging into those areas as well. We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how the entire data workflow operates and taking ownership of making it reliable. Responsibilities Build, deploy, and maintain production ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL. Develop and maintain data models in Snowflake using modern data engineering practices. Own scheduled and event-driven workflows from source ingestion through downstream delivery. Develop, deploy, and troubleshoot workflows running through Prefect or similar orchestration platforms such as Airflow or Dagster. Build and support containerized data applications and pipelines using Docker. Help maintain reproducible local and production development environments. Monitor production pipelines and proactively identify failures, stale data, data-quality issues, and infrastructure problems. Troubleshoot issues across Python applications, containers, orchestration workers, APIs, networking, credentials, and cloud infrastructure. Implement logging, alerting, retries, validation, testing, and recovery/backfill strategies. Use Git-based development workflows including branches, pull requests, code review, and controlled production deployments. Help establish and improve engineering standards around CI/CD, environment management, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment. Work directly with analysts and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business problems into reliable data solutions. Technical experience we're looking for Strong SQL and Python. Production ETL/ELT pipeline development. Hands-on experience with a workflow orchestration platform such as Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, Kestra, or similar. Hands-on Docker/container experience, including building, running, debugging, and maintaining containerized applications. Experience supporting production data pipelines and troubleshooting failures. Git and collaborative software development workflows. Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake. Understanding of data validation, monitoring, logging, retries, idempotency, and production recovery. We'd love if you have Experience administering or supporting orchestration workers/agents and their runtime environments. CI/CD experience for data applications and pipelines. AWS, Azure, GCP, or DigitalOcean infrastructure experience. Experience with container registries, environment variables, secrets management, and application configuration. Linux/server administration and troubleshooting experience. Infrastructure-as-code experience such as Terraform. dbt or similar transformation frameworks. Experience managing development, test, and production environments. We offer Competitive salary and incentives Inclusive benefits package including 401(k), medical, dental, and vision Generous paid time off Professional development and growth opportunities Collaborative and innovative work environment About Brighton In 1972, our founders Jerry and Terri Kohl set out with a simple but bold idea: create beautifully crafted accessories that feel personal, meaningful, and made to last. They believed that artistry matters and that customers should be treated like lifelong friends. That belief still fuels us today. At Brighton's headquarters, you'll find a community of passionate creators, problem-solvers, and innovators. Our buying team imagines what's next, our account specialists and shipping experts keep our nationwide network moving with precision, and our in-house artisans bring each design to life with extraordinary skill. We even have dedicated teams who restore and refresh beloved pieces so they can continue their journey with the people who cherish them. Joining us means stepping into a place where heritage craftsmanship meets forward-thinking design. We're a company grounded in heart, yet always reaching for what's possible. Here, you're not just part of a brand, you're part of building the future of retail, one thoughtfully crafted handbag, necklace, and charm at a time.
